answer.text:
Question 3

Is the signal x(t) = sin(t) absolutely integrable over (-\infty, \infty)?
Potential answers:
I: Yes, because it is periodic.
II: No, because \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} |sin(t)| dt diverges.
III: Yes, because its amplitude is bounded.
IV: No, because it is not a decaying signal.
V: I do not know.

II: No, because it is not a decaying exponential.
III: Yes, because it is symmetric about t = 0.
IV: No, because it is not periodic.

answer.description: The slide presents a theorem stating that an LTI system is BIBO stable if and only if its impulse response is absolutely integrable. It includes a definition of BIBO stability and some specific conditions for h(t).
answer.text:
Theorem: an LTI system is BIBO stable if and only if its impulse response is absolutely integrable

h(t) BIBO stable if and only if \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} |h(\tau)| d\tau < +\infty

h(t) = \begin{cases} 0 & t<0 \\ \cos(10t) & t \ge 0 \end{cases}
